# React Bits components

FlexCarousel, TearTicket and AccordionGallery were adapted from https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits.
The original MIT + Commons Clause license and copyright notice are included in LICENSE.md.

Local adaptations add carousel navigation controls, localized labels and pointer coordinates for a diagonal carousel layout.
AccordionGallery also supports localized pending-animation panels, keyboard focus navigation, touch and a responsive vertical layout.
